exposure: fetomaternal Doppler sonography (umbilical artery pulsatility index (PI), middle cerebral artery (MCA) PI, cerebroplacental ratio (CPR), mean uterine artery PI, cerebro-placental-uterine ratio (CPUR))
cohort: The study included 88 cases of singleton, non-anomalous fetuses of women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) who primarily had a vaginal delivery attempt and no other major fetomaternal abnormalities.
finding: Fetomaternal Doppler indices, including CPUR which had borderline significance, showed poor ability to significantly predict combined adverse perinatal outcome (CAPO) in term pregnancies complicated by gestational diabetes mellitus.
